source.publication: TIR 95-9: Income Taxation of Contributory Public Employee Pensions of Other States (Massachusetts DOR, 01/10/1996)
source.section: Department's Position After Pariser, Examples 1 and 2 (age test and 20,000 cap per recipient); 2025 Form 1 Instructions PDF p10 Line 4 second bullet and PDF p22-23 Schedule Y Line 13; Form 1 lines 2a, 2c, 4, 15-22; tax table PDF p38

worked: Federal AGI = New York State contributory public employee pension 30,000.00 (person 0) + New York State contributory public employee pension 18,000.00 (person 1) = 48,000.00 (given). Federal taxable income = 48,000.00 - 31,500.00 standard deduction (31,500.00) = 16,500.00 (given, not tested; the federal senior deduction is ignored). Massachusetts Form 1 (the projection starts from federal AGI and takes out the exempt items): Line 4 taxable pensions = 30,000.00 New York State contributory public employee pension (included in line 4, then Schedule Y line 13) + 18,000.00 New York State contributory public employee pension (included in line 4, then Schedule Y line 13) = 48,000.00. Line 10 total 5.0% income = 48,000.00. Schedule Y line 13 (New York State contributory pension, TIR 95-9: up to 20,000 a person who has attained 59 1/2): person 0: age 64, 30,000.00 received, capped at 20,000.00 = 20,000.00; person 1: age 57, under 59 1/2, nothing = 0.00; total 20,000.00 -> Schedule Y line 19 -> Form 1 line 15 = 20,000.00. Line 16 total deductions = 20,000.00. Line 17 = 48,000.00 - 20,000.00 = 28,000.00. Line 2a personal exemption (married_joint) = 8,800.00; line 2c age 65 or over before 2026: 0 x 700.00 = 0.00; line 2g = line 18 = 8,800.00. Line 19 = 28,000.00 - 8,800.00 = 19,200.00. Line 20 interest and dividends = 0.00. Line 21 = 19,200.00. Line 22 = 19,200.00 x 0.05 = 960.00 (line 21 is under 24,000, so the form uses the tax table, PDF p38: the table gives 961). No 8.5%/12% income or long-term gains (lines 23-24 = 0.00); 4% surtax 0.00 (line 21 is under 1,083,150). Line 28 total tax = 960.00; no credits (No Tax Status and the Limited Income Credit do not apply: Massachusetts AGI 48,000.00 is over their limits). State income tax = 960.00. Each person is tested and capped separately: the 20,000 is not shared, and person 1's age does not borrow person 0's.
